commands.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "1db4d3fae8b889838cd25cba5dd4eb85b20b6fa6"; test -z "$(git status --short)"

set +e; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run --reporter=json --outputFile=/tmp/mobile-vitest.json >/tmp/mobile-vitest.stdout 2>/tmp/mobile-vitest.stderr; status=$?; set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/mobile-vitest.json')
if not p.exists():
    print('VITEST_JSON_MISSING')
    print(Path('/tmp/mobile-vitest.stderr').read_text()[-12000:])
    raise SystemExit(0)
data=json.loads(p.read_text())
print(f"SUMMARY failed_tests={data.get('numFailedTests')} passed_tests={data.get('numPassedTests')} failed_suites={data.get('numFailedTestSuites')} passed_suites={data.get('numPassedTestSuites')}")
for result in data.get('testResults', []):
    failed=[a for a in result.get('assertionResults', []) if a.get('status') == 'failed']
    if not failed:
        continue
    print('FILE', result.get('name'))
    for a in failed:
        print('TEST', ' > '.join(a.get('ancestorTitles', []) + [a.get('title','')]))
        msgs=a.get('failureMessages') or []
        for msg in msgs:
            compact=' '.join(str(msg).split())
            print('ERROR', compact[:1800])
PY
exit 0
